name: Pitch-Compensated Anisotropic Condition-Aware Uncertainty Scaling

inputs.distance_m: Radial ground-plane distance from camera optical center to tracked target (meters)
inputs.illumination_lux: Local ambient photometric sensor lux measurement (lux)
inputs.camera_pitch_deg: Calibrated extrinsic camera tilt angle relative to horizontal ground plane (degrees)
inputs.sigma_base: Nominal ground-plane baseline standard deviation: sigma_base = 0.018 + (distance * 0.0035) for Sector C, 0.022 + (distance * 0.0045) for Sector D

formula: k_H = k0 + beta_d * max(0.0, distance_m - 4.0) + beta_l * max(0.0, 300.0 - illumination_lux) / 100.0 + beta_pitch * I(camera_pitch_deg < 40.0) + gamma_occ
derivation_rationale: Model H adds beta_pitch * I(pitch < 40 deg) = 0.22 to compensate for the perspective compression along the optical axis observed in Sector D (pitch=36 deg vs calibration pitch=42.5 deg). This provides the necessary margin for elongated error ellipses without unnecessarily inflating intervals in Sector C (pitch=48 deg).
